description: Verification vector for the inputs a verifier brings (security review of 0.5.0: F1, F5, F10, F12). Run every case through your verifier as for 13_verdicts.json, with the named dossier, the named trusted directory from `directories` (none when null), threshold, min_witnesses, known_heads, subject_org and the named evidence items, passed as the raw JSON values under `evidence`. An evidence item is a JSON object: the proof itself, or the proof under "proof" as `witness serve` writes it; the proof is an object whose origin, log_vkey, earlier_note and conflicting_note are strings. An equivocation proof verifies only under the verifier key built from its canonical origin (key ID included); its notes are c2sp.org/signed-note with at most 64 signature lines, strict base64, and key names that are non-empty with no '+' and no Unicode White_Space (a line breaking this makes the note malformed, known key or not). A known head's size is any u64 and surrounding Unicode White_Space is ignored (U+FEFF is not White_Space). Labels (operator_org, subject_org) are compared after splitting on Unicode White_Space, joining with one space and Unicode full default lowercasing (SpecialCasing, Final_Sigma included). exit_code 2 means the verifier must refuse the inputs (the CLI's usage error, an exception from a library) instead of returning a verdict; the other expect fields are then null. Otherwise the verdict, exit code and report fields must equal expect, as in 13_verdicts.json. Every key here is public and for testing only.
